groups.description: Live mental wellbeing platforms this domain is modeled on or benchmarked against — useful to see how member, employer, and care surfaces are positioned in practice.

links.title: Cadre — the social platform for better mental health
links.relevance: The primary reference product for the domain; shows how community, daily live sessions, and individual/employer/contributor paths are framed for the Everyday Member and Contributor personas.

links.title: Headspace for Employers
links.relevance: Benchmark for combining self-guided content with employer-sponsored access — the buying surface the People and Benefits Leader persona compares Cadre against.

links.title: Modern Health — workforce mental health platform
links.relevance: Reference for an employer-sponsored platform blending coaching, therapy, and global care operations, framing the activation and care-escalation expectations of employer buyers.

groups.description: Background on workplace mental health demand and the digital wellbeing market that shapes employer and member strategy.

links.title: WHO — Mental health at work
links.relevance: Establishes the workplace mental health need and productivity case that the People and Benefits Leader persona uses to justify and renew the benefit.

links.title: Unmind for Employers
links.relevance: Shows how a workplace-prevention challenger packages manager enablement and proactive content, context for the HR Program Administrator persona's programming decisions.

groups.description: Reputable clinical and safety sources that ground the privacy, moderation, and escalation requirements that are foundational in this sensitive health domain.

links.title: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
links.relevance: The authoritative crisis-escalation resource the platform must route to when community support is insufficient — directly informs the Everyday Member escalation and safety-moderation flows.

links.title: U.S. HHS — Health Information Privacy (HIPAA)
links.relevance: The regulatory baseline for handling sensitive health data and employer–member data separation that the People and Benefits Leader and HR Program Administrator personas depend on for confidentiality.

links.title: NIMH — Help for Mental Illnesses
links.relevance: A trusted clinical-authority resource directory that anchors the platform's care-navigation and referral guidance for members who need higher-touch support.

groups.description: Resources aimed at the experts, peers, and facilitators who supply content, host live sessions, and answer questions.

links.title: Mental Health First Aid
links.relevance: A widely recognized training credential that supports the Contributor / Facilitator persona's vetting, safe-practice, and credibility expectations on the platform.
